reproducing_statement: Retain real macOS launcher/browser opener outcome and exact unavailable native observation attempts; distinguish served UI HTTP from visual acceptance.

browser_attempts.outcome: Inventory exposes a Chrome extension browser without the new local app tab; no private inventory content retained

visual_acceptance: Unverified: available CUA surfaces cannot observe the native browser window. No screenshot or visible UI pass claimed.

opener_evidence.selection: Unmodified scripts/runtime.mjs browserCommand Darwin branch; invoked by scripts/start.mjs after ready/health.
opener_evidence.observed: Launcher remained alive without browser-opening failure; multiple UI bootstrap HTTP requests appeared immediately afterwards in native-start.log. OS opener completion and HTTP requests do not prove a visible/rendered native UI.
opener_evidence.retained_log_limit: Sanitized request entries omit URL/status objects, so the retained log alone cannot identify UI bootstrap endpoints. Explicit http_probes separately record served HTML/JS/CSS outcomes.

sanitation_provenance.retained_hash_scope: Existing log_hashes match the retained sanitized files, not original command streams.
transformations: Source checkout, installed Node path and host home paths are replaced by symbolic labels.
native-start.log request/response detail objects are omitted; a runtime event message is replaced by Runtime event; private details omitted.
sanitation_provenance.limits: The exact post-capture sanitizer command and before/after hashes were not retained. Do not treat retained hashes as original-byte hashes or omitted request details as independently replayable evidence.

later_documentation_candidate.kind: Later documentation-only review candidate; no new native setup/start/browser execution.

documentation_overlay_provenance: documentation_overlay_refresh preserves the original investigator-recorded previous/final hashes and copied_while_runtime_healthy observations. No per-copy command/timestamp log was retained. Those values are historical observations, not proof that a subsequent candidate was copied while healthy; the later_documentation_candidate was not copied or run.
